description: This file defines a mock class 'GstGenericPlayerClientMock' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IGstGenericPlayerClient' interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for various notifications related to media playback, network state, QoS, and buffer underflow, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerClientMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IGstGenericPlayerClient for testing, providing mock methods for media playback notifications and state changes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of media data requirement.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of media position updates.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of network state changes.

methods.name: clearActiveRequestsCache
methods.description: Mock method to simulate clearing of active requests cache.

methods.name: invalidateActiveRequests
methods.description: Mock method to simulate invalidation of active requests for a given media source type.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of QoS information.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of buffer underflow events.
